notes.title: Kickstarter campaign ends!
notes.content:
From the Grimorio of Games team, thank you so much for believing in the project! Thanks to your support [b]we made it to the top 10 Spanish videogame Kickstarter campaigns ever[/b]!

[h2]Thanks to the backers, we will have:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Additional fully voice acted scenes!
[*] More music by Dale North and Emi Evans!
[*] 2 New game modes! Boss Rush, Colosseum
[*] 2 extra bosses and 2 extra Revenant summons (designed by the backers!)
[*] A customizable character that will be part of the story!
[/list]

[b]We didn't manage to reach the Challenge Dungeon goal, nor the 3D remake of the first [i]Sword of the Necromancer game[/i][/b], but don't worry! 

Maybe we can't make the 50-level Challenge Dungeon, but we can slip some kind of post-game challenge anyway (one easier and cheaper to make). As for the remake, we can wait until we start selling [i]Revenant [/i]to fund it, or maybe ask for your help in the future with a new campaign exclusively for it.

But rest assured that we will definitely make [i]Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection[/i]!

[h2]About the Social Stretch Goals, backers and followers helped us unlock:[/h2]

[list]
[*] A building material pack
[*] 3 new weapon types: Katana, Naginata and Dual Knives
[*] A special unique shield: the Aegis
[*] A new optional boss: the Whispike Queen
[*] 2 sets of costumes: Classic and Alternative
[/list]

All of these unlocks will be given for free as a DLC key to all the backers of the game.

[h1]Again, thanks for your support![/h1]
